These are account-level characters and specimen observations, not estimates of all species variation.

claims.text: The authors report Syspira longipes from xeric areas of the Baja California Peninsula and list several microhabitats, including bare soil, fallen wood, leaf litter, gravel, cobbles, above-ground vegetation, beach areas, and sites near oases. This records the treatment's literature-based habitat observations, not an exclusive or complete niche.
